cat <<'EOF' > /app/artifacts/overlay_script.py
import nibabel as nib, numpy as np, os
inp = '/app/input/case_7f3a9c_mri.nii.gz'
img = nib.load(inp)
data = img.get_fdata()
# Simple heuristic: prostate is lower intensity region around center
# Compute z-slice middle
z_mid = data.shape[2]//2
slice_mid = data[:,:,z_mid]
# Threshold using Otsu from skimage
from skimage.filters import threshold_otsu
thr = threshold_otsu(slice_mid)
mask = data < thr  # prostate tends to be darker
# Refine by keeping central region
center = (np.array(data.shape)//2)
# create spherical mask radius
X, Y, Z = np.ogrid[:data.shape[0], :data.shape[1], :data.shape[2]]
dist = np.sqrt((X-center[0])**2 + (Y-center[1])**2 + (Z-center[2])**2)
mask = np.logical_and(mask, dist < data.shape[0]//4)
mask_img = nib.Nifti1Image(mask.astype(np.uint8)*255, img.affine, img.header)
out = '/app/artifacts/prostate_red_overlay.nii.gz'
nib.save(mask_img, out)
print('Saved', out)
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > /app/artifacts/overlay_script.py
import nibabel as nib, numpy as np
inp = '/app/input/case_7f3a9c_mri.nii.gz'
img = nib.load(inp)
data = img.get_fdata()
z_mid = data.shape[2]//2
slice_mid = data[:,:,z_mid]
thr = slice_mid.mean()
mask = data < thr
center = np.array(data.shape)//2
# compute distance map
coords = np.indices(data.shape)
dist = np.sqrt(((coords[0]-center[0])**2 + (coords[1]-center[1])**2 + (coords[2]-center[2])**2))
mask = np.logical_and(mask, dist < data.shape[0]//4)
mask_img = nib.Nifti1Image((mask.astype(np.uint8))*255, img.affine, img.header)
out = '/app/artifacts/prostate_red_overlay.nii.gz'
nib.save(mask_img, out)
print('Saved', out)
EOF
